preceding_paragraph: Table S9 | Sensor degradation with the projection residual and a trimmed variant. 200 queries (100 non-sensor junctions × 5 and 20 L s⁻¹; seed 31; component noise s.d. 0.02 m) scored by recall of the resolvable-location class containing the true junction (74 classes at cosine 0.999 for the deployed 30 sensors; Supplementary Note 1.5) and by the median Euclidean distance from the retrieved class centroid to the true junction in network-coordinate units. Trimmed discards the worst 20% of per-sensor squared residual terms for each template before ranking. Drift is a per-sensor Gaussian offset present in the event window but not in the baseline; constant bias is the same offset present in both windows; missing channels are excluded from the residual; stuck sensors report their baseline value; spikes add 1 m to 5% of readings; the combined condition applies drift (s.d. 0.15 m), 10% missing channels, two stuck sensors and spikes. Single realization; no uncertainty estimate.
rows: Impulsive spikes (1 m) on 5% of readings
Combined: drift 0.15 m + 10% missing + two stuck + spikes
